ch0192_40_matsubusa/0101_0701_01_10:
Oh, it’s you, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
Will you also be participating in the
Midnight Parade?
ch0192_40_matsubusa/0101_0701_02_10:
Team Magma plans to enjoy the festivities.
Relaxation is necessary at times, is it not?
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7101_0701_01_10:
Some children were pestering Tabitha and
Courtney for candy.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7101_0701_02_10:
Perhaps they mistook their Team Magma
uniforms for costumes.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7101_0701_03_10:
From now on, I shall allocate a portion of
Team Magma’s budget to candy distribution.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7102_0701_01_10:
Ting-Lu is a Pokémon that was created
when fear poured into an ancient ritual
vessel clad itself in rocks and dirt.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7102_0701_02_10:
It’s remarkably apt for a frightful celebration,
wouldn’t you say?
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7103_0701_01_10:
The Midnight Parade’s fervid atmosphere
reminds me of magma.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7103_0701_02_10:
It’s positively overflowing with humanity’s
hidden possibilities!
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7104_0701_01_10:
I’m learning about Terastallization at Pasio
Academy. It’s rather fascinating.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7104_0701_02_10:
The school’s lectures must be educational for
you as well.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7105_0701_01_10:
Watching you, [Name:PlayerNickname ],
I feel strongly that humanity can attain even
greater heights.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7105_0701_02_10:
You have influenced a number of promising
individuals.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/7105_0701_03_10:
I consider myself one of those you’ve
inspired.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/1701_0701_01_10: I have something to give you. Take this.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/1701_0702_01_10: No need to hesitate. Use it well.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0701_01_10:
They say Ting-Lu has the power to create
fissures in the earth.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0701_02_10:
In other words, it can alter the very ground
we walk on.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0701_03_10:
It’s similar to Groudon in that respect. I shall
continue to research whether this can be
used for humanity’s progress.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0702_01_10: If Ting-Lu can create land like Groudon...
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0702_02_10:
then it is deeply fascinating. I must study it
further!
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2501_0702_03_10:
Ting-Lu remains veiled in mysteries. If you
discover anything, please tell me.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2511_0701_01_10:
During ancient times in Hoenn, Groudon and
Kyogre violently opposed one another with
the power of Primal Reversion.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2511_0701_02_10:
The earth cracked beneath torrential rainfall
as nature’s fury sent Hoenn to the brink of
collapse.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2511_0702_01_10:
That’s right—nature’s energy can be both
humanity’s salvation and ruin.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2511_0702_02_10:
The immense power of Ting-Lu, a beckoner
of ruin, may very well be the key to saving
people and Pokémon.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/2511_0702_03_10:
I must face it with caution, as both its
Trainer and partner.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/3001_0701_01_10:
Would you like to join Team Magma’s
morning briefing? You might learn something
valuable.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/3003_0701_01_10:
Humans require fuel just as machines do.
Make sure you eat something to keep your
energy up.
ch0192_40_matsubusa/3005_0701_01_10:
Pasio is brimming with excitement tonight.
How about we observe this energy, study it,
and employ it for humanity’s progress?
